nat_rewrite: (h0 h1 : Nat) | ∀ c : Nat, (h0 + h1) + c = (h0 + c) + h1
nat_induction: (h0 h3 : Nat) | Nat.succ h0 + h3 = Nat.succ (h0 + h3)
list_induction: induct_list h3 as h5 h6 h7
(h0 h1 : Type) (h2 : h0 → h1) (h3 h4 : List h0) | List.map h2 (h3 ++ h4) = List.map h2 h3 ++ List.map h2 h4
list_exists: (h0 : Type) (h1 : h0) | ∀ xs : List h0, ∃ ys : List h0, List.length ys = Nat.succ (List.length xs) ∧ List.tail ys = xs
tree_induction: change 1 + (PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h4) + PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h3)) = 1 + (PilotTree.nodes h3 + PilotTree.nodes h4)

(h0 : Type) (h3 h4 : PilotTree h0) (h5 : PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h3) = PilotTree.nodes h3) (h6 : PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h4) = PilotTree.nodes h4) | PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror (PilotTree.branch h3 h4)) = PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.branch h3 h4)
